name: TrueMandate Governance Agent
description: Governed reference agent for the TrueMandate semantic trust and governance runtime. Records durable intents and reads the canonical proof projection through the TrueMandate public API. Holds zero economic execution surface: proposals are transported and verified by the SDK, and authorization happens only inside TrueMandate infrastructure. Procurement is the canonical proof scenario, not the product surface.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Google Cloud Run IAM identity token. Callers present a Google-issued ID token (audience = the service URL) as a Bearer credential and must hold an explicit roles/run.invoker grant on the service. No allUsers invocation exists.

skills.name: Record governed intents
skills.description: Records a durable raw Intent in the TrueMandate trust core. Recording does not compile, authorize, or execute anything — the trust pipeline starts only inside TrueMandate infrastructure.
examples: Record this intent: buy 500 food-grade containers from an approved supplier for under INR 800000.

skills.name: Read the canonical proof
skills.description: Reads the canonical Phase C v5 proof projection — a fixed-allowlist, read-only view of the verified governed procurement (intent, authority decision, execution, outcome, resolution). No write path exists for this skill.
examples: Show the canonical proof of the last governed procurement.
